verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents all four channels in the story: unlimited voice call alerts plus SMS, e-mail and push notifications (docs-29). Phone-call paging with press-1 acknowledgement (docs-11) and app-based single-tap acknowledgement (docs-19) back this up. Nothing in the evidence shows an on-call engineer choosing their own channels or setting per-channel notification rules; escalation policies cover who is alerted and in what order, not which channel. Missing for 10: documented per-user channel preferences, per-channel notification rules (e.g. delays or ordering per channel), independent or hands-on corroboration.
